anchor_query:
PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?var1 ("P3866" AS ?var2) (concat(", ?var3 , ") AS ?var4)
WHERE
  { BIND(strafter(?var5, "DE/") AS ?var3)
    BIND(replace(str(?var6), ".*Q", "Q") AS ?var1)
    ?var6  wdt:P1183  ?var5
    FILTER strstarts(?var5, "DE/")
    FILTER regex(?var5, "^DE/.{8,}$")
    MINUS
      { ?var6  wdt:P3866  ?var7 }
  }
ORDER BY ASC(?var5)

anchor_query:
PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX  wde:  <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?var1 (COUNT(DISTINCT ?var2) AS ?var3) ?var4
WHERE
  { BIND(if(EXISTS { ?var2  wdt:P50  wde:Q30338957 }, "string1", "string2") AS ?var4)
    BIND(str(year(?var5)) AS ?var1)
    ?var6  wdt:P50    wde:Q30338957 .
    ?var2  wdt:P2860  ?var6 ;
           wdt:P577   ?var5
  }
GROUP BY ?var1 ?var4
ORDER BY DESC(?var1)

PREFIX  url:  <http://schema.org/>

SELECT  ?var1Label ?var2 ?var3 ?var4 ?var5 ?var6
WHERE
  { OPTIONAL
      { wde:Q16337990
                  rdfs:label  ?var1Label
        FILTER ( lang(?var1Label) = ?var7 )
        VALUES ( ?var7 ?var8 ) {
          ( "fr" 1 )
          ( "en" 2 )
          ( "de" 3 )
          ( "fr" 4 )
          ( "it" 5 )
        }
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { wde:Q16337990
                  wdt:P18  ?var3
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { wde:Q16337990
                  <urn:dboabstract>  ?var2
        FILTER ( lang(?var2) = "fr" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { wde:Q16337990
                  wdt:P625  ?var4
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?var6  rdf:type        url:Article ;
               url:about       wde:Q16337990 ;
               url:inLanguage  "fr" ;
               url:isPartOf    <https://fr.wikipedia.org/>
      }
  }
ORDER BY ASC(?var8)
